actions.text: Hovering the anchor opens the tooltip; it stays open while the pointer moves toward the tooltip through a safe polygon.
Focusing the anchor opens the tooltip when the content role is 'tooltip'.
Clicking the anchor toggles the tooltip on mobile browsers or when the content role is 'dialog'.
The tooltip can be dismissed with the standard dismiss interactions (such as Escape or an outside press).

rules.text: A tooltip never shows when isDisabled is true; isDisabled defaults to false.
The content role defaults to 'tooltip'; when it is 'dialog', the anchor gets role button and the content is wrapped in a non-modal focus manager with no initial focus.
The anchor is keyboard focusable (tabIndex 0) by default, unless isAnchorFocusable is false.
The tooltip is offset 10 px from the anchor and may flip and shift to stay in the viewport; flipping is allowed by default (canFlip true).
The floating box's maximum width and height are limited to the available space in the viewport, never below 0.
Mobile is detected by a mobile-device check on the browser.
The tooltip kind defaults to the default kind and affects the styling of the arrow and box; its placement comes from the position prop.

shows.text: Shows an anchor element inline; the tooltip content is displayed in a floating box next to it when open.
The floating box contains a small arrow pointing to the anchor and the tooltip body content.
The floating content is rendered in the portal root element and is not rendered when the tooltip is closed or disabled.
The anchor carries an optional accessible label as its aria-label.

findings.explanation: Code uses useHover with safePolygon, but that it opens on hover is fine; however 'stays open while pointer moves toward it' is supported. Minor: no issue found beyond this.
findings.reason: The reviewer concedes the statement is supported; useHover with safePolygon is in the source.
